correctness.rationale: The incidence matrix of K_n gives adjacency eigenvalues 2(n−2), n−4, −2, hence L spectrum 0,n,2(n−1). Independent symbolic spectral interpolation reproduced exactly diagonal 2Q_n/D, adjacent hE_n/D, nonadjacent H_n/D; the latter has strictly positive coefficients for h>0. Independent Sturm checks verified Q4,Q5 and E74 have no positive roots; discriminant(E74)=-24660792741888. For n≥6, Q_n(1)<0 and two Descartes sign changes yield exactly two positive roots; E_n(h=z/n) decreases strictly with n, while E_n(1/5)<0 for n≥75, again with two-root Descartes bound. Representative exact witnesses Q6(1)=-102 and E75(1/5)=-18/25 support sharpness. The proofs, not finite matrix examples, establish all integer n and real h.
residual_risks: Only unweighted simple triangular graphs J(n,2) and completed Radau IIA endpoint maps, not arbitrary weights, stages, or other methods.

value.rationale: Two exactly separated size thresholds identify distinct positivity failures (self and neighbor transitions) of a stable third-order heat integrator on a canonical infinite family of strongly regular graphs. A complete algebraic criterion for every timestep and proof that nonadjacent entries never go negative are meaningful graph-diffusion invariants.
residual_risks: This is an exact specialist graph family, not a new method-wide SSP coefficient.

final_claim: For unweighted triangular J(n,2), completed two-stage Radau IIA is nonnegative at all h≥0 iff n≤5. Self-transition negativity begins at n=6 on exactly one interval, neighbor-transition negativity begins at n=75 on exactly one interval, and every nonadjacent entry stays positive for h>0.
